data: Is the value of the blue square position in the left corner higher than 0.5?

The blue square position in the left corner represents the value for bin 1 in layer 1. From the caption and the figure, we can see that this value is 0.240. Since 0.240 is less than 0.5, the value of the blue square position in the left corner is not higher than 0.5. Therefore, the answer is no.
